args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/evidence-package-generation /mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-package-generation
python /mnt/skills/custom/ffmpeg-utils/scripts/run.py --operation keyframe --input-path /mnt/datasets/Vedio-demo/Trafic.mp4 --timestamp 1 --output-path /mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-package-generation/source.jpg --output /mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-package-generation/keyframe_result.json
python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
event = {"event_id":"EVT_PACKAGE_001","video_id":"video-traffic-agent-test","camera_id":"CAM_DEERFLOW_001","event_type":"manual_evidence","event_time":"2026-05-20T10:00:01+08:00","event_elapsed_seconds":1,"image_uri":"/mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-package-generation/source.jpg","raw_segment_uri":"/mnt/datasets/Vedio-demo/Trafic.mp4","evidence_frame_ids":["frame_001"]}

p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
json.dump(event, p.open('w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
PY
python /mnt/skills/custom/evidence-package-generation/scripts/run.py --event-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-package-generation/event.json --output-dir /mnt/user-data/outputs/evidence-package-generation/package --index citybrain-video-library --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/evidence-package-generation/result.json
